claims.claim: The PageRank model is described in the Stanford report The PageRank Citation Ranking: Bringing Order to the Web.
claims.locator: Page, Brin, Motwani & Winograd, Stanford technical report

claims.claim: PageRank uses a random-surfer transition with teleportation for directed links.
claims.locator: PageRank algorithm, damping and personalization arguments

claims.claim: Dangling nodes with no outedges redistribute probability mass using the dangling distribution, avoiding probability leakage.
claims.locator: Dangling parameter and default personalization redistribution

claims.claim: HITS computes separate hub and authority scores, unlike PageRank's single stationary distribution.
claims.locator: Kleinberg (1999), Authoritative Sources in a Hyperlinked Environment
